category_definitions.Demonstrated: Direct reported observation in an inspected primary source, under its reported conditions; not independently replicated here.
category_definitions.Strongly supported: Convergent source evidence supports a bounded interpretation; not universal proof.
category_definitions.Suggestive: Grounded rationale that does not establish causal or quantitative transfer.
category_definitions.Hypothesized: Proposed testable extension; no new outcomes generated.
category_definitions.Unknown: Unresolved, uninspected or not yet measured.
category_definitions.Refuted: The explicitly stated assertion is contradicted by identified evidence; scope of refutation is limited.

claims.claim: SGC reports MRK-952 biochemical IC50 85 nM versus NC 10 micromolar; NC is weakly active, not inert.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Prose reports the IC50 values. Curve tables label EC50 0.0849 and 10.6 micromolar, respectively.
limits: IC50/EC50 label discrepancy; not independent measurements.
Species/construct not specified in inspected dossier.
NC stereochemistry explicitly assumed.

claims.claim: The SPR panel reports KD 0.031 ± 0.018 and 1.380 ± 0.380 micromolar (n=2) for MRK-952 and NC.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Both probes have NUDT5 binding values; NUDT14 is marked NB and the footnote says also inactive in NUDT14 catalytic assay.
limits: No numerical nonbinding/inactivity cutoff is specified in the inspected figure.
This is not a proteome-wide cellular selectivity guarantee.

claims.claim: Compound 9 binds NUDT5 and NUDT14, and retains BTK engagement in cells.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: NUDT5 NanoBRET EC50 1.08 ± 0.07 micromolar; BTK EC50 0.377 ± 0.062 micromolar; NUDT14 CETSA measured at 30 micromolar.
limits: Different readouts are not interchangeable occupancy measures.
Cellular selectivity at the intended exposure must be measured.

claims.claim: Balikci catalytic inhibition assays used different incubation times for NUDT5 and NUDT14.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: NUDT5 was incubated for 20 minutes and NUDT14 for 1 hour.
claims.exact_quote: NUDT5 reactions were incubated for 20 min, while NUDT14 reactions were carried out for 1 h at rt.
limits: Published IC50 ratios are not affinity constants or matched-kinetic comparisons.

claims.claim: TH5427 reduced hormone-stimulated nuclear luciferase signal and downstream hormone responses in the reported T47D system.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: The study links a reduced nuclear ATP reporter signal to chromatin, transcription and proliferation endpoints.
claims.exact_quote: cells treated with TH5427 had a marked reduction in nuclear luminescence
limits: Source-specific model and exposure.
Reporter interference, general toxicity and noncatalytic mechanisms must be controlled in a new experiment.

claims.claim: In the tested thiopurine setting, TH5427 and MRK-952 failed to reproduce the NUDT5-knockout resistance phenotype, whereas protein loss and rescue experiments gave distinct results.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: The paper compares catalytic inhibitors, genetic knockout, degrader/control and E112Q reconstitution.
claims.exact_quote: neither inhibitor was able to phenocopy the NUDT5 KO in HAP1 or HL-60 cells
limits: This does not demonstrate the same behavior in hormone-stimulated T47D.
A universal equivalence claim is contradicted; not every catalytic role is excluded.

claims.claim: Nguyen reports that Y74E disrupts NUDT5–PPAT interaction while retaining catalytic activity in the reported ADP-ribose assay; E112Q supplies a complementary catalytic-deficient comparison.
claims.locator: Figs. 4–6; Y74-mutant Results; Enzymatic activity Methods
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Y74E loses PPAT binding and differs from WT/E112Q in the reported purine-stress rescue experiments.
claims.exact_quote: We confirmed that mutation of residue Y74 did not affect NUDT5 catalytic activity
limits: Mutants need requalification in T47D, including localization and ATP-producing reaction competence.
PPAT complex geometry is AlphaFold-predicted, not an experimentally solved complex.

claims.claim: NUDT5 has a noncatalytic PPAT-associated contribution to purine regulation in the studied contexts.
claims.locator: S7 Figs. 4–6; S6 Fig. 4 and Discussion
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Chemical depletion, catalytic inhibition, genetic rescue, interaction experiments and purified-protein PPAT experiments converge.
limits: Shared investigators/toolkit; do not count as fully independent replication.
Not proof of universal scaffolding dependence across breast-cancer phenotypes.

claims.claim: The proposed general noncatalytic/PPAT mechanism is already published and cannot honestly be presented as newly discovered by this project.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Both primary papers explicitly investigate catalytic-independent NUDT5 functions.
limits: A distinct context-specific mechanistic result could still be new; exhaustive novelty search not performed.

claims.verification_status: published structural rationale; causal test pending
claims.claim: Arg51-dependent recognition may distinguish ligand interactions between NUDT5 and NUDT14.
claims.locator: S4 Figs. 3–4 and Results; S5 TH5427 structure; supplied structural caveats
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Published contact assignments distinguish the NUDT5 Arg51 environment from the NUDT14 pocket.
limits: No new contact distances, energy calculation or mutagenesis performed.
The supplied Arg51 occupancy warning is inherited and requires local-density inspection.

claims.verification_status: producer selectivity evidence; intended use untested
claims.claim: MRK-952 is a candidate orthogonal NUDT5 comparator for a NUDT14 deconvolution panel.
claims.locator: SGC selectivity panel; S6 inhibitor comparison
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Different chemical scaffold and reported NUDT14 inactivity support testing it beside TH5427 and compound 9.
limits: No qualified T47D engagement window or proteome-wide selectivity in that system.
Purified-assay species/construct unresolved.

claims.claim: Acute hormone-response catalysis and purine-stress PPAT dependence can be separated by qualified E112Q/Y74E rescue.
claims.locator: Extension hypothesis informed by these sources
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: The sources establish distinct experimental contexts and published separation-of-function tools.
limits: No T47D mutant or paired-context experiment performed.
Different cell lines alone cannot establish a context interaction.

claims.claim: A ligand-by-Arg51-mutant binding interaction can guide a prospectively measured NUDT5-over-NUDT14 selectivity change.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: A differential binding experiment can test the contact rationale before new chemistry.
limits: R51K/R51A are proposed, not validated resistance alleles.
Existing SAR remeasurement is retrospective.

claims.claim: A fixed activity-ranking rule will prefer MRK-952 to NC under a prespecified scoring interpretation.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Published biochemical and direct-binding results motivate a known-answer, one-pair challenge.
limits: Outcomes already exposed; no blinded external-validation claim.
No scores computed or actual training-overlap check performed.
The scorer may not make a potency claim at all.

claims.claim: Species and construct of the SGC purified-enzyme measurements remain unresolved from inspected sources.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: The published cell use does not supply the missing biochemical assay identity.
limits: Blocks strict species-confirmed human biochemical holdout status; does not invalidate producer observations.

claims.claim: Overlap with all 45 repository graphs, actual model behavior, reagent availability, cost and laboratory capability remain unassessed.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Prior similarity calculations concern retrieved Balikci graphs rather than all project structures.
limits: Repository files and vendors were not searched.

claims.claim: Mutant integrity, compartment localization, PPAT binding, dual-reaction competence and target-engagement windows in T47D remain untested.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: Published validation in other systems does not close these requirements.
limits: No experimental outcomes or prospectively validated predictions supplied.

claims.claim: Catalytic inhibition and NUDT5 protein loss are universally interchangeable interventions.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: The tested purine/thiopurine contexts provide counterexamples.
limits: Refutation is of the universal statement, not a claim that inhibitors can never phenocopy depletion.

claims.claim: MRK-952-NC is an experimentally inactive NUDT5 compound.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: NC has micromolar inhibition and binding.
limits: It may function as a weak comparator within a qualified exposure window.

claims.verification_status: contradicted by primary target engagement and binding
claims.claim: Balikci compound 9 is a NUDT5-specific cellular probe.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: NUDT14 direct binding and cellular stabilization, plus BTK cellular engagement, contradict unqualified specificity.
limits: An exposure-dependent functional attribution could still be established experimentally.

claims.claim: NUDT5–PPAT scaffolding or generic catalytic-inhibitor/degrader discordance would be a first discovery here.
claims.supporting_passage_paraphrase: These findings are already directly reported in 2025/2026 primary papers.
limits: No exhaustive assessment of the novelty of the narrower H1 extension.
